~11x prefill, ~4x decode vs CPU on the same file
the Metal GPU engine fails on this model family at runtime (tracked upstream); CPU is verified

measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): gpu decodes 54.5 tok/s against cpu's 40.46 (1.3x), prefill 1018.3 vs 79.6-86.5 tok/s, peak 618 vs 1332 MB, engine init 6.6 vs 4.4 s. Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win for gpu on decode. int4_gpu is the GPU-lineage export; on this handset's CPU it decodes 40 tok/s, level with the CPU-lineage int8 file (39-41 tok/s, same day, same harness), so the GPU is where the flagship class gains. Both backends answered the probe correctly

platform_notes: Large --max-num-tokens costs decode speed on this family (~-24% at 4096 vs 1024)
GPU backends keep a compiled-model cache (~2x model size) next to the model until the OS purges it
